messages.subject: Bioc-training call March 10, 3-4pm CET
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

a quick reminder about the bioc-training call on Monday, March 10, 3-4pm CET. Note that Europe will still be on winter time next week, while I believe that the US will have already changed to summer time - please double-check the time in your timezone :) (thanks to Jenny for the reminder).
Jitsi link: https://meet.jit.si/BioconductorTeaching

Charlotte & Laurent
